hooks.command: for d in ../AI-Dev-Workspace ../ai-dev-workspace; do [ -f "$d/scripts/hooks/guard-db-schemas.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/scripts/hooks/guard-db-schemas.sh"; done; INPUT=$(cat); Q=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; t=(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}); print(t.get("query") or t.get("command") or "")' 2>/dev/null) || Q=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.query // .tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null) || Q=''; q=$(printf '%s' "$Q" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); case "$q" in *pgrst*db_schemas*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; printf '%s' "$q" | grep -Eq 'set[[:space:]]+"?pgrst"?[[:space:]]*\.[[:space:]]*"?db_schemas"?|"?pgrst"?[[:space:]]*\.[[:space:]]*"?db_schemas"?[[:space:]]*(=|to[[:space:]])' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$Q" | grep -q 'db_schemas-full-union-verified' && exit 0; echo 'BLOCKED: pgrst.db_schemas is a LIST - append, never assign (3rd incident 2026-08-09, AIDW issue #591). Read rolconfig from pg_roles first, write the FULL union of existing+new schemas, include the marker comment -- db_schemas-full-union-verified in the statement, then NOTIFY pgrst reload config AND reload schema. Mirror the list in the Supabase dashboard afterwards.' >&2; exit 2
for d in ../AI-Dev-Workspace ../ai-dev-workspace; do [ -f "$d/scripts/session-start.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/scripts/session-start.sh"; done; exit 0

for d in ../AI-Dev-Workspace ../ai-dev-workspace; do [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/gh-tasks-read.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/.claude/hooks/gh-tasks-read.sh"; done; [ -f .claude/hooks/gh-tasks-read.sh ] && exec bash .claude/hooks/gh-tasks-read.sh; exit 0
for d in ../AI-Dev-Workspace ../ai-dev-workspace; do [ -f "$d/scripts/distill-gate.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/scripts/distill-gate.sh"; done; exit 0
